newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent edges higher as API stats seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent edges higher as API stats seen mixed.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude prices were higher on Wednesday supported by short covering after API data were viewed as offering mixed signals.
December was last traded at $22.27 per barrel, up eight cents from London's settlement of $22.19.
Brokers said American Petroleum Institute (API) data was mixed for the market.
Crude stocks increased 9.3 million barrels but distillate stocks fell 429,000 barrels nationally, although they grew 875,000 barrels in the key PADD 1.
In the absence of clear direction from the data, brokers said the market was supported by a perception that price had tumbled far enough for now.
NYMEX December crude was last traded at $22.71, up seven cents from the New York close. But December heating oil was last traded at 66.21 cents per gallon, up 0.79 cents from the New York close.
Brokers said they would now look to the Energy Information Administration data Wednesday for further stocks direction.
